approvers: Developer / main contractor via subcontract package
reason: I pay about €12 a m² all-in with my own labour and spend under €4,000 a year on this. €19 a m² is over 50% more, with a 150 m² minimum and a deposit, for a problem I already solve. Also they are a contractor and I don't want them on my site seeing my programme.
objection: It costs more than my film and tape, and the developer decides what protection is specified anyway, so nobody is paying me extra for it. I also don't want a competitor on site.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film, plastic sheet or board with tape, applied by my own labour.
would_change_my_mind: A developer or main contractor specifying it in the subcontract package and paying for it, at or below what I pay now per m².
